source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְכָל־הַקָּהָ֔ל שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה בְנִ֥י אֶחָ֛ד בָּֽחַר־בּ֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים נַ֣עַר וָרָ֑ךְ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְאָדָם֙ הַבִּירָ֔ה כִּ֖י לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said David the king to all the assembly, Solomon my son, one [whom] has chosen him God, [is] young and tender, and the work [is] great, for not for man [is] the palace, but for Yahweh God.

en.L: And David the king said to all the assembly, "Solomon my son, the one whom God has chosen, [is] young and tender, and the work [is] great, for the palace [is] not for {{gender:a human|man}} but for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God.
en.B: King David then spoke to the whole assembly: "God has chosen my son Solomon alone, but he is young and inexperienced, and the task is great, because this palace is not for {{gender:a human being|man}} but for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God.
en.R: Then King David said to all the people gathered there, "God has chosen my son Solomon, and only him. But Solomon is young and has little experience, and the work is great. This palace is not for {{gender:a human being|a man}}. It is for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God.

es.L: Y dijo el rey David a toda la asamblea: «Salomón mi hijo, el único a quien Dios ha escogido, [es] joven y tierno, y la obra [es] grande, porque el palacio no [es] para {{gender:un ser humano|hombre}}, sino para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios.
es.B: Luego el rey David habló a toda la asamblea: «Dios ha escogido solo a mi hijo Salomón, pero él es joven y sin experiencia, y la obra es grande, porque este palacio no es para {{gender:un ser humano|un hombre}}, sino para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios.
es.R: Entonces el rey David les dijo a todos los reunidos allí: «Dios ha escogido a mi hijo Salomón, y solo a él. Pero Salomón es joven y tiene poca experiencia, y el trabajo es grande. Este palacio no es para {{gender:un ser humano|un hombre}}. Es para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios.

fr.L: Et le roi David dit à toute l’assemblée : « Salomon mon fils, le seul que Dieu ait choisi, [est] jeune et tendre, et l’ouvrage [est] grand, car le palais n’[est] pas pour {{gender:un être humain|l’homme}}, mais pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu.
fr.B: Le roi David dit alors à toute l’assemblée : « Dieu a choisi mon fils Salomon, lui seul, mais il est jeune et sans expérience, et la tâche est immense, car ce palais n’est pas destiné à {{gender:un être humain|un homme}}, mais {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} Dieu.
fr.R: Ensuite le roi David a dit à tous ceux qui étaient rassemblés là : « Dieu a choisi mon fils Salomon, et lui seul. Mais Salomon est jeune et il n’a pas beaucoup d’expérience, et le travail est immense. Ce palais n’est pas pour {{gender:un être humain|un homme}}. Il est pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu.

sw.L: Mfalme Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote, "Sulemani mwanangu, yule ambaye Mungu amemchagua, [ni] kijana na mchanga, na kazi [ni] kubwa, kwa maana jumba hili si kwa ajili ya mwanadamu bali kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu.
sw.B: Kisha mfalme Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote, "Mungu amemchagua mwanangu Sulemani peke yake, lakini yeye ni kijana na hana uzoefu, na kazi hii ni kubwa, kwa sababu jumba hili si kwa ajili ya mwanadamu bali ni kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme Daudi akawaambia watu wote waliokusanyika pale, "Mungu amemchagua mwanangu Sulemani, yeye peke yake. Lakini Sulemani ni kijana, naye hana uzoefu mwingi, na kazi ni kubwa. Jumba hili si kwa ajili ya mwanadamu. Ni kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu.

vi.L: Vua Đa-vít nói với toàn thể hội chúng: "Sa-lô-môn con tôi, người duy nhất Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn, [còn] trẻ và non nớt, mà công việc thì lớn lao, vì đền đài này không phải cho loài người, nhưng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua Đa-vít nói với toàn thể hội chúng: "Đức Chúa Trời chỉ chọn một mình Sa-lô-môn con tôi, nhưng nó còn trẻ và thiếu kinh nghiệm, mà công việc thì lớn lao, vì đền đài này không phải dành cho loài người, mà cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Rồi vua Đa-vít nói với toàn dân đang nhóm họp tại đó: "Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn Sa-lô-môn con tôi, và chỉ một mình nó thôi. Nhưng Sa-lô-môn còn trẻ và ít kinh nghiệm, mà công việc thì lớn lao. Đền đài này không phải dành cho loài người. Nó dành cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗 왕이 온 회중에게 말했다. "하나님께서 오직 그 하나만을 택하신 내 아들 솔로몬은 어리고 연약하고, 일은 큽니다. 이 궁전은 사람을 위한 것이 아니라 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님을 위한 것이기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 다윗 왕이 온 회중에게 말했다. "하나님께서 오직 내 아들 솔로몬을 택하셨지만, 그는 어리고 경험이 없으며 이 일은 큽니다. 이 궁전은 사람을 위한 것이 아니라 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님을 위한 것이기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 그리고 다윗 왕이 그곳에 모인 모든 백성에게 말했다. "하나님께서 내 아들 솔로몬을, 오직 그만을 택하셨습니다. 그러나 솔로몬은 어리고 경험이 부족하며, 할 일은 큽니다. 이 궁전은 사람을 위한 것이 아닙니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님을 위한 것입니다.

decisions.choice: palace: a great fortified royal building, here the temple
decisions.reason: The word names a citadel or fortified palace. It is used of the royal citadel at Susa (Nehemiah 1:1; Esther 1:2) and of the fortress beside the temple (Nehemiah 2:8). Calling the temple by this word sets the house of Yahweh beside a king's palace: it is a royal residence, but its king is God, not a human ruler. The word comes again in verse 19.

decisions.choice: the one whom God has chosen: the one son chosen
decisions.reason: The word 'one' stresses that of David's many sons (3:1-9) God chose Solomon alone to sit on the throne and build the house (28:5-6).

decisions.choice: young and tender: young and inexperienced
decisions.reason: David said the same in 22:5. The pair describes youth without experience, not weakness of body; Solomon calls himself 'a young boy' who does not know how to lead in 1 Kings 3:7.

decisions.choice: a human / a human being, with 'man' as the alternative
decisions.reason: The word means a human being in general, set against God, so the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: {{gender:un ser humano|un hombre}}
decisions.reason: Spanish has two wordings for the Hebrew "man" meaning a human being, so it keeps the English gender setting.

decisions.choice: "un être humain" (default), "l’homme" / "un homme" (alternative)
decisions.reason: French "homme" here means any human being, so the gender setting of the English applies in French too, with the inclusive wording as default, as the French style guide sets for *ʾādām*-like nouns.

decisions.choice: mwanadamu (no gender span)
decisions.reason: "Mwanadamu" means a human being, man or woman, so Swahili has no second wording for the English gender setting here.

decisions.choice: "loài người", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "loài người" names humankind without marking men, so the English gender setting has no second wording here.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "사람"
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" already means a human being of either sex, set against God, so the English setting has nothing to change; David speaks to the assembly in 합쇼체, as in 28:2.

source.text: וּֽכְכָל־כֹּחִ֞י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית־אֱלֹהַ֗י הַזָּהָ֣ב׀לַ֠זָּהָב וְהַכֶּ֨סֶף לַכֶּ֜סֶף וְהַנְּחֹ֣שֶׁת לַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת הַבַּרְזֶל֙ לַבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְהָעֵצִ֖ים לָעֵצִ֑ים אַבְנֵי־שֹׁ֨הַם וּמִלּוּאִ֜ים אַבְנֵי־פ֣וּךְ וְרִקְמָ֗ה וְכֹ֨ל אֶ֧בֶן יְקָרָ֛ה וְאַבְנֵי־שַׁ֖יִשׁ לָרֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And with all my strength I have prepared for [the] house of my God the gold for the gold and the silver for the silver and the bronze for the bronze, the iron for the iron, and the wood for the wood, stones of onyx and settings, stones of antimony and varied color, and every stone precious, and stones of alabaster in abundance.

en.L: And with all my strength I have prepared for the house of my God the gold for the [things of] gold, and the silver for the [things of] silver, and the bronze for the [things of] bronze, the iron for the [things of] iron, and the wood for the [things of] wood, onyx stones and [stones for] settings, stones of antimony and of varied colors, and every [kind of] precious stone, and alabaster stones in abundance.
en.B: With all my strength I have provided for the house of my God: gold for the things of gold and silver for the things of silver, bronze and iron for what is to be made of them, and timber for the woodwork, along with onyx stones and stones for setting, dark antimony stones and stones of many colors, every kind of precious stone, and alabaster in great quantity.
en.R: I have worked as hard as I could to get things ready for the house of my God. I have gathered gold and silver, bronze and iron, and timber, each for the objects to be made from it. I have also gathered onyx and other stones to be set in place, dark stones, stones of many colors, all kinds of valuable jewels, and a great amount of fine white stone.

es.L: Y con todas mis fuerzas he preparado para la casa de mi Dios el oro para las [cosas de] oro, y la plata para las [cosas de] plata, y el bronce para las [cosas de] bronce, el hierro para las [cosas de] hierro, y la madera para las [cosas de] madera, piedras de ónice y [piedras de] engaste, piedras de antimonio y de diversos colores, y toda [clase de] piedra preciosa, y piedras de alabastro en abundancia.
es.B: Con todas mis fuerzas he provisto para la casa de mi Dios oro para los objetos de oro y plata para los de plata, bronce y hierro para lo que se ha de hacer con ellos, y madera para la obra de madera, además de piedras de ónice y piedras para engastar, piedras oscuras de antimonio y piedras de muchos colores, toda clase de piedras preciosas y alabastro en gran cantidad.
es.R: He trabajado todo lo que he podido para dejar listas las cosas para la casa de mi Dios. He reunido oro y plata, bronce y hierro, y madera, cada material para los objetos que se harán con él. También he reunido ónice y otras piedras para engastar, piedras oscuras, piedras de muchos colores, toda clase de joyas valiosas y una gran cantidad de piedra blanca fina.

fr.L: Et de toute ma force j’ai préparé pour la maison de mon Dieu l’or pour [ce qui est d’]or, et l’argent pour [ce qui est d’]argent, et le bronze pour [ce qui est de] bronze, le fer pour [ce qui est de] fer, et le bois pour [ce qui est de] bois, des pierres d’onyx et [des pierres] à enchâsser, des pierres d’antimoine et de couleurs variées, et toutes [sortes de] pierres précieuses, et des pierres d’albâtre en abondance.
fr.B: De toutes mes forces j’ai préparé pour la maison de mon Dieu l’or pour les objets d’or et l’argent pour les objets d’argent, le bronze et le fer pour ce qui doit en être fait, et le bois pour les ouvrages de bois, ainsi que des pierres d’onyx et des pierres à enchâsser, des pierres sombres d’antimoine et des pierres de diverses couleurs, toutes sortes de pierres précieuses, et de l’albâtre en grande quantité.
fr.R: J’ai travaillé de toutes mes forces pour tout préparer pour la maison de mon Dieu. J’ai rassemblé de l’or et de l’argent, du bronze et du fer, et du bois, chacun pour les objets qu’on doit en faire. J’ai aussi rassemblé de l’onyx et d’autres pierres à monter, des pierres sombres, des pierres de toutes les couleurs, toutes sortes de pierres précieuses, et une grande quantité de belle pierre blanche.

sw.L: Kwa nguvu zangu zote nimeiandalia nyumba ya Mungu wangu dhahabu kwa ajili ya [vitu vya] dhahabu, na fedha kwa ajili ya [vitu vya] fedha, na shaba kwa ajili ya [vitu vya] shaba, chuma kwa ajili ya [vitu vya] chuma, na mbao kwa ajili ya [vitu vya] mbao, mawe ya shohamu na [mawe ya] kujaza, mawe ya rangi nyeusi na ya rangi mbalimbali, na kila [aina ya] jiwe la thamani, na mawe ya marmar kwa wingi.
sw.B: Kwa nguvu zangu zote nimeiandalia nyumba ya Mungu wangu: dhahabu kwa vitu vya dhahabu na fedha kwa vitu vya fedha, shaba na chuma kwa vitu vitakavyotengenezwa kwa hivyo, na mbao kwa kazi ya mbao, pamoja na mawe ya shohamu na mawe ya kujaza, mawe meusi na mawe ya rangi nyingi, kila aina ya jiwe la thamani, na marmar kwa wingi.
sw.R: Nimefanya kazi kwa bidii kadiri nilivyoweza ili kuandaa mahitaji ya nyumba ya Mungu wangu. Nimekusanya dhahabu na fedha, shaba na chuma, na mbao, kila kimoja kwa vitu vitakavyotengenezwa kwacho. Nimekusanya pia mawe ya shohamu na mawe mengine ya kupachikwa, mawe meusi, mawe ya rangi nyingi, kila aina ya vito vya thamani, na mawe mengi meupe mazuri.

vi.L: Tôi đã hết sức chuẩn bị cho nhà Đức Chúa Trời của tôi: vàng cho [các vật bằng] vàng, bạc cho [các vật bằng] bạc, đồng cho [các vật bằng] đồng, sắt cho [các vật bằng] sắt, gỗ cho [các vật bằng] gỗ, đá hồng mã não và [đá để] khảm, đá đen và đá nhiều màu, mọi [loại] đá quý, và rất nhiều đá cẩm thạch trắng.
vi.B: Tôi đã hết sức chuẩn bị cho nhà Đức Chúa Trời của tôi: vàng cho các vật bằng vàng, bạc cho các vật bằng bạc, đồng và sắt cho những vật làm bằng đồng và sắt, gỗ cho các đồ gỗ, cùng với đá hồng mã não và đá để khảm, đá đen và đá nhiều màu, đủ mọi loại đá quý, và rất nhiều đá cẩm thạch trắng.
vi.R: Tôi đã cố gắng hết sức để chuẩn bị cho nhà Đức Chúa Trời của tôi. Tôi đã thu góp vàng, bạc, đồng, sắt và gỗ, mỗi thứ để làm những vật cần đến nó. Tôi cũng đã thu góp đá hồng mã não và những loại đá khác để khảm, đá màu sẫm, đá nhiều màu, đủ loại ngọc quý, và rất nhiều đá trắng đẹp.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 온 힘을 다해 내 하나님의 집을 위하여 준비했습니다. 금[으로 만들 것]을 위해 금을, 은[으로 만들 것]을 위해 은을, 놋[으로 만들 것]을 위해 놋쇠를, 철[로 만들 것]을 위해 철을, 나무[로 만들 것]을 위해 나무를, 그리고 마노와 박을 [보석]과 안티몬 돌과 여러 색깔의 돌과 온갖 귀한 돌과 대리석을 많이 [준비했습니다].
ko.B: 나는 온 힘을 다해 내 하나님의 집을 위하여 준비했습니다. 금으로 만들 것에는 금을, 은으로 만들 것에는 은을, 놋과 철로 만들 것에는 놋쇠와 철을, 나무로 만들 것에는 나무를 마련했고, 마노와 박을 보석과 검은 안티몬 돌과 여러 색깔의 돌과 온갖 보석과 대리석도 많이 마련했습니다.
ko.R: 나는 힘을 다해 내 하나님의 성전을 지을 준비를 했습니다. 금과 은과 놋쇠와 철과 나무를 모아, 저마다 그것으로 만들 물건에 쓰게 했습니다. 또 마노와 박아 넣을 돌들과 검은 돌과 여러 색깔의 돌과 온갖 값진 보석과 희고 고운 돌도 많이 모았습니다.

decisions.choice: the gold for the gold: the material for each kind of object
decisions.reason: The repeated pairs mean the gold for what was to be made of gold, the silver for what was to be made of silver, and so on, as in the list of 28:14-18.

decisions.choice: onyx stones and stones for setting
decisions.reason: The same pair appears among the gifts for the tabernacle (Exodus 25:7; 35:9). The first is a precious stone often taken as onyx or carnelian; the second means stones to be mounted, as in the high priest's breastpiece (Exodus 28:17).

decisions.choice: antimony: dark stones
decisions.reason: The word elsewhere names the black eye paint made from antimony (2 Kings 9:30), and in Isaiah 54:11 God sets Jerusalem's stones 'in antimony'. Here it may mean dark stones, or a dark material in which other stones were set.

decisions.choice: alabaster: a fine white stone
decisions.reason: The word appears only here in this form; a closely related word names white stone in Esther 1:6. It is a fine white stone, alabaster or marble.

decisions.choice: gold for the things of gold / gold for the gold objects
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out what the bare pairs mean the first time, then shorten them as the list goes on.

decisions.choice: mawe ya shohamu; mawe meusi; marmar
decisions.reason: The stones are named as plainly as Swahili allows ("shohamu" for onyx, "marmar" for alabaster); Readable describes them, as the English does. The exact stones are uncertain.

source.text: וְע֗וֹד בִּרְצוֹתִי֙ בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֔י יֶשׁ־לִ֥י סְגֻלָּ֖ה זָהָ֣ב וָכָ֑סֶף נָתַ֤תִּי לְבֵית־אֱלֹהַי֙ לְמַ֔עְלָה מִכָּל־הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לְבֵ֥ית הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And moreover, in my delighting in [the] house of my God, there is to me a treasure, gold and silver; I give [it] for [the] house of my God, upward above all [that] I have prepared for [the] house of the holiness:

en.L: And moreover, in my delight in the house of my God, there is to me a treasured possession of gold and silver; I give [it] to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:
en.B: Moreover, because I delight in the house of my God, I am giving my own treasure of gold and silver to the house of my God, over and above everything I have provided for the holy house:
en.R: I love the house of my God so much that I am also giving my own treasure of gold and silver for it. This is in addition to everything I have already gathered for the holy house.

es.L: Y además, por mi amor a la casa de mi Dios, tengo un tesoro propio de oro y de plata; lo doy para la casa de mi Dios, por encima de todo lo que he preparado para la casa santa:
es.B: Además, porque amo la casa de mi Dios, entrego mi propio tesoro de oro y de plata para la casa de mi Dios, por encima de todo lo que he provisto para la casa santa:
es.R: Amo tanto la casa de mi Dios que también le doy mi propio tesoro de oro y de plata. Esto es además de todo lo que ya he reunido para la casa santa.

fr.L: Et de plus, dans mon affection pour la maison de mon Dieu, j’ai un trésor à moi, d’or et d’argent ; je [le] donne pour la maison de mon Dieu, en plus de tout ce que j’ai préparé pour la maison du sanctuaire :
fr.B: De plus, parce que j’aime la maison de mon Dieu, je donne pour la maison de mon Dieu mon trésor personnel d’or et d’argent, en plus de tout ce que j’ai préparé pour la maison sainte :
fr.R: J’aime tellement la maison de mon Dieu que je donne aussi pour elle mon propre trésor d’or et d’argent. Cela s’ajoute à tout ce que j’ai déjà rassemblé pour la maison sainte.

sw.L: Tena, kwa kupendezwa kwangu na nyumba ya Mungu wangu, nina hazina yangu mwenyewe ya dhahabu na fedha; ninaitoa kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Mungu wangu, zaidi ya yote niliyoiandalia nyumba takatifu:
sw.B: Zaidi ya hayo, kwa sababu ninapendezwa na nyumba ya Mungu wangu, ninatoa hazina yangu mwenyewe ya dhahabu na fedha kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Mungu wangu, zaidi ya yote niliyoiandalia nyumba takatifu:
sw.R: Naipenda sana nyumba ya Mungu wangu, hata ninatoa pia hazina yangu mwenyewe ya dhahabu na fedha kwa ajili yake. Hii ni zaidi ya yote ambayo nimekwisha kukusanya kwa ajili ya nyumba takatifu.

vi.L: Hơn nữa, vì tôi yêu mến nhà Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi có của riêng là vàng và bạc; tôi dâng [nó] cho nhà Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, ngoài mọi thứ tôi đã chuẩn bị cho ngôi nhà thánh:
vi.B: Hơn nữa, vì lòng tôi yêu mến nhà Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi xin dâng kho vàng bạc riêng của tôi cho nhà Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, ngoài mọi thứ tôi đã chuẩn bị cho ngôi nhà thánh:

ko.L: 그리고 또 내가 내 하나님의 집을 기뻐하므로, 나에게 있는 금과 은의 보물을 거룩한 집을 위해 준비한 모든 것 외에 내 하나님의 집에 드립니다.
ko.B: 그뿐 아니라 나는 내 하나님의 집을 사랑하기 때문에, 거룩한 집을 위해 준비한 모든 것 외에 내가 가진 금과 은의 보물을 내 하나님의 집에 드립니다.
ko.R: 나는 내 하나님의 성전을 너무나 사랑하기 때문에, 내가 가진 금과 은의 보물도 그 성전을 위해 드립니다. 이것은 내가 거룩한 성전을 위해 이미 모아 둔 것 외에 더 드리는 것입니다.

decisions.choice: treasure: a private, prized possession
decisions.reason: The word means property kept as one's own special treasure, like the treasure of kings in Ecclesiastes 2:8. God uses it of Israel as 'my treasured possession' (Exodus 19:5). David gives from his personal wealth, not only from the stores he had already set aside as king.

decisions.choice: delight: love and pleasure in God's house
decisions.reason: The verb means to take pleasure in or be pleased with. David's gift springs from his love for the house of God (compare Psalm 26:8). The same verb is used of God's pleasure in uprightness in verse 17.

decisions.choice: I love the house of my God so much that
decisions.reason: Readable turns 'in my delight' into a plain statement of why David gives.

source.text: שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים כִּכְּרֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מִזְּהַ֣ב אוֹפִ֑יר וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת אֲלָפִ֤ים כִּכַּר־כֶּ֨סֶף֙ מְזֻקָּ֔ק לָט֖וּחַ קִיר֥וֹת הַבָּתִּֽים׃

ko.B: 오빌의 금으로 금 {{units:102톤쯤|3,000달란트}}과, 건물들의 벽을 입힐 정련한 은 {{units:238톤쯤|7,000달란트}}을 드립니다.

decisions.choice: Ophir: a distant land famous for its gold
decisions.reason: Solomon's ships later brought gold from Ophir (1 Kings 9:28; 10:11). Its location is unknown; southern Arabia, the east coast of Africa and India have all been suggested. 'Gold of Ophir' was a byword for the finest gold (Job 28:16; Psalm 45:10).

decisions.choice: talents: very large weights
decisions.reason: A talent was about 75 pounds, so these are enormous amounts: Solomon's whole yearly income of gold was 666 talents (1 Kings 10:14). Added to the 100,000 talents of gold already set aside (22:14), the figures present David's gift as beyond counting.

decisions.choice: the houses: the buildings and rooms of the temple
decisions.reason: The plural most likely means the temple's buildings and rooms (28:11), whose walls were to be overlaid with precious metal (2 Chronicles 3:4-9).

decisions.choice: modern weight, with talents as the alternative
decisions.reason: A talent is about 75 pounds, so 3,000 talents is about 225,000 pounds and 7,000 about 525,000 pounds; the round figures in tons are easier to take in.

decisions.choice: from Ophir, the finest gold
decisions.reason: Readable adds what 'gold of Ophir' meant to the first hearers.

decisions.choice: unas 100 toneladas; unas 240 toneladas
decisions.reason: At 34 kg a talent, as in the Spanish of Kings, rounded; the English gives American tons.

decisions.choice: "environ 100 tonnes"; "environ 240 tonnes"
decisions.reason: The talent is converted at 34 kg and rounded, as the Kings terms note sets.

decisions.choice: karibu tani 100; karibu tani 240 (talanta 3,000; talanta 7,000)
decisions.reason: The metric default reckons a talent at 34 kg, rounded as the English rounds; Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: {{units:khoảng 102 tấn|3.000 ta-lâng}}; {{units:khoảng 238 tấn|7.000 ta-lâng}}
decisions.reason: Metric at 34 kg a talent, the original unit as the alternative; the English's tons are US tons.

decisions.choice: {{units:102톤쯤|3,000달란트}}; {{units:238톤쯤|7,000달란트}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default (talent 34 kg), in tonnes so the amounts can be pictured, as at 22:14; Literal keeps the talents.

records.literal_gloss: the gold for the gold, and the silver for the silver, and for all [the] work by [the] hand of craftsmen. And who [is] offering willingly to fill his hand today for Yahweh?

en.L: the gold for the [things of] gold, and the silver for the [things of] silver, and for all the work by the hand of craftsmen. And who [is] offering willingly to fill his hand today for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?"
en.B: gold for the things of gold and silver for the things of silver, and for all the work to be done by craftsmen. Now who is willing to give freely and consecrate {{gender:themselves|himself}} today to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?"
en.R: The gold and silver are for all the gold and silver objects and for all the work the skilled workers will do. Now, who else will gladly bring a gift today and so dedicate {{gender:themselves|himself}} to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?"

es.L: el oro para las [cosas de] oro, y la plata para las [cosas de] plata, y para toda la obra de mano de los artesanos. ¿Y quién está dispuesto a llenar hoy su mano para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}?».

fr.B: l’or pour les objets d’or et l’argent pour les objets d’argent, et pour tout le travail que feront les artisans. Maintenant, qui veut donner de bon cœur et se consacrer aujourd’hui {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ? »

sw.R: Dhahabu na fedha ni kwa ajili ya vitu vyote vya dhahabu na fedha, na kwa kazi yote watakayoifanya mafundi stadi. Sasa, ni nani mwingine atakayeleta zawadi leo kwa moyo mkunjufu, na hivyo kujitoa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?"

vi.L: vàng cho [các vật bằng] vàng, bạc cho [các vật bằng] bạc, và cho mọi công việc do tay thợ thủ công làm. Vậy hôm nay ai tự nguyện dâng tay mình cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?"
vi.B: vàng cho các vật bằng vàng, bạc cho các vật bằng bạc, và cho mọi công việc do thợ thủ công làm. Vậy bây giờ, hôm nay ai sẵn lòng dâng hiến và biệt mình ra cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?"
vi.R: Vàng và bạc ấy dùng cho mọi vật bằng vàng, bằng bạc và cho mọi công việc thợ thủ công sẽ làm. Bây giờ, hôm nay còn ai vui lòng dâng lễ vật và qua đó hiến mình cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nữa không?"

ko.L: 금[으로 만들 것]을 위해 금을, 은[으로 만들 것]을 위해 은을, 그리고 장인들의 손으로 하는 모든 일을 위해 [드립니다]. 그러면 오늘 누가 기꺼이 자기 손을 채워 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 [드리겠습니까]?"
ko.B: 금으로 만들 것에는 금을, 은으로 만들 것에는 은을, 그리고 장인들이 할 모든 일을 위해 드립니다. 이제 오늘 누가 기꺼이 자기를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바치겠습니까?"
ko.R: 그 금과 은은 금 물건과 은 물건을 만들고, 솜씨 좋은 일꾼들이 할 모든 일에 쓰일 것입니다. 이제 오늘 또 누가 기꺼이 예물을 가져와 자기를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바치겠습니까?"

decisions.choice: fill his hand: consecrate himself by bringing a gift
alternatives: fill his hand with a gift
decisions.reason: To 'fill the hand' is the phrase used for installing priests in their office (Exodus 28:41; 29:9). Here David invites the assembly to set themselves apart for Yahweh, and the next verses show that they did so by giving. The picture of hands filled with gifts may also be in view.

decisions.choice: offering willingly: giving freely, of one's own accord
decisions.reason: The verb is used of freewill gifts and of volunteering (Exodus 35:29; Judges 5:2, 9). It runs through this chapter (verses 6, 9, 14, 17): the gifts were not a tax but given gladly.

decisions.choice: themselves / himself
decisions.reason: David's question is open to the whole assembly, so the inclusive pronoun is the default.

decisions.choice: who else will gladly bring a gift
decisions.reason: David has just told of his own gift, so Readable adds 'else' and spells out the sense of giving freely.

decisions.choice: llenar su mano
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of "filling the hand", used for consecration; Balanced and Readable say "consagrarse". Spanish "consagrarse" covers men and women, so no gender span is needed.

decisions.choice: "se consacrer", with no gender setting
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: The French reflexive "se" covers men and women alike, so the English setting has no French counterpart here.

decisions.choice: kujiweka wakfu; kujitoa (no gender span)
decisions.reason: The reflexive "-ji-" covers anyone, so Swahili has no second wording for the English gender setting; Literal keeps the Hebrew "to fill his hand", the idiom for consecration.

decisions.choice: "mình", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "ai" and "mình" already cover men and women, so the English gender setting has no second wording here.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "자기"
decisions.reason: Korean "자기" refers to anyone in the assembly, men or women, so the English setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "자기 손을 채워"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "fill one's hand", used for consecrating; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

source.text: וַיִּֽתְנַדְּבוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י׀שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְשָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וְהַמֵּא֔וֹת וּלְשָׂרֵ֖י מְלֶ֥אכֶת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And offered willingly [the] princes of the fathers and [the] princes of [the] tribes of Israel and [the] commanders of the thousands and the hundreds, and the princes of [the] work of the king.

en.L: And the princes of the fathers' [houses] and the princes of the tribes of Israel and the commanders of the thousands and the hundreds and the princes over the work of the king offered willingly.
en.B: Then the family leaders and the tribal leaders of Israel gave freely, together with the commanders over thousands and hundreds and the officials who managed the king's work.
en.R: Then the leaders of the families and of the tribes of Israel, the army commanders over thousands and over hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king's work all gladly gave gifts.

es.L: Y ofrecieron voluntariamente los jefes de las [casas] paternas, y los jefes de las tribus de Israel, y los jefes de millares y de centenas, y los jefes de la obra del rey.
es.B: Entonces los jefes de familia y los jefes de las tribus de Israel dieron de buena gana, junto con los comandantes de millares y de centenas y los oficiales encargados de las obras del rey.
es.R: Entonces los jefes de las familias y de las tribus de Israel, los comandantes del ejército sobre millares y sobre centenas, y los oficiales encargados de las obras del rey dieron todos sus ofrendas con alegría.

fr.L: Et les princes des [maisons des] pères, et les princes des tribus d’Israël, et les chefs de milliers et de centaines, et les intendants de l’ouvrage du roi donnèrent de bon cœur.
fr.B: Alors les chefs de famille et les chefs des tribus d’Israël, avec les chefs de milliers et de centaines et les intendants des affaires du roi, donnèrent de bon cœur.
fr.R: Alors les chefs de famille et les chefs des tribus d’Israël, les officiers qui commandaient mille hommes ou cent hommes, et les responsables des travaux du roi ont tous donné de bon cœur.

sw.L: Wakuu wa [nyumba za] baba na wakuu wa makabila ya Israeli na makamanda wa maelfu na wa mamia na wakuu juu ya kazi ya mfalme wakatoa kwa hiari.
sw.B: Kisha viongozi wa jamaa na viongozi wa makabila ya Israeli walitoa kwa hiari, pamoja na makamanda wa maelfu na wa mamia na maafisa waliosimamia kazi ya mfalme.
sw.R: Kisha viongozi wa jamaa na wa makabila ya Israeli, makamanda wa jeshi wa maelfu na wa mamia, na maafisa wanaosimamia kazi ya mfalme wote walitoa zawadi kwa moyo mkunjufu.

vi.L: Các thủ lĩnh các gia tộc, các thủ lĩnh các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, các quan chỉ huy ngàn quân và trăm quân, và các thủ lĩnh coi sóc công việc của vua đều tự nguyện dâng hiến.
vi.B: Bấy giờ các trưởng tộc và các nhà lãnh đạo các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên đều sẵn lòng dâng hiến, cùng với các quan chỉ huy ngàn quân và trăm quân, và các quan chức quản lý công việc của vua.
vi.R: Bấy giờ những người lãnh đạo các gia tộc và các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, các quan chỉ huy ngàn quân và trăm quân, và các quan chức phụ trách công việc của vua đều vui lòng dâng lễ vật.

ko.L: 그러자 조상들의 [집의] 고관들과 이스라엘 지파들의 고관들과 천부장들과 백부장들과 왕의 일을 맡은 고관들이 기꺼이 드렸다.
ko.B: 그러자 가문의 지도자들과 이스라엘 지파의 지도자들과 천부장들과 백부장들과 왕의 일을 맡은 관리들이 기꺼이 예물을 드렸다.
ko.R: 그러자 집안의 지도자들과 이스라엘 지파의 지도자들과, 천 명과 백 명을 거느린 군대 지휘관들과, 왕의 일을 맡은 관리들이 모두 기쁘게 예물을 드렸다.

decisions.choice: princes of the fathers: heads of the family groups
decisions.reason: 'The fathers' is short for 'the fathers' houses', the extended families (24:4; 27:1). Their heads stand first among the givers.

decisions.choice: commanders of thousands and hundreds: the army's officers
decisions.reason: The army was organized in units of thousands and hundreds (27:1; 28:1).

decisions.choice: offered willingly: as Israel gave for the tabernacle
decisions.reason: As the people once gave freely for the tabernacle (Exodus 35:21-29), so the leaders now give freely for the temple.

decisions.choice: leaders / commanders / officials
decisions.reason: The word is 'princes' at Literal. Balanced and Readable say 'leaders' for the heads of families and tribes and 'officials' for those over the king's work, which suits each office; the army officers are 'commanders' at every level.

source.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֞וּ לַעֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֣ים חֲמֵֽשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים֮ וַאֲדַרְכֹנִ֣ים רִבּוֹ֒ וְכֶ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּנְחֹ֕שֶׁת רִבּ֛וֹ וּשְׁמוֹנַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים כִּכָּרִ֑ים וּבַרְזֶ֖ל מֵֽאָה־אֶ֥לֶף כִּכָּרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they gave for [the] service of [the] house of God gold, talents five thousand and darics ten thousand, and silver, talents ten thousand, and bronze, ten thousand and eight thousand talents, and iron, one hundred thousand talents.

en.L: And they gave for the service of the house of God: gold, 5,000 talents and 10,000 darics; and silver, 10,000 talents; and bronze, 18,000 talents; and iron, 100,000 talents.
en.B: For the service of the house of God they gave {{units:about 190 tons|5,000 talents}} and {{units:about 185 pounds|10,000 darics}} of gold, {{units:about 375 tons|10,000 talents}} of silver, {{units:about 675 tons|18,000 talents}} of bronze and {{units:about 3,750 tons|100,000 talents}} of iron.
en.R: They gave all this for the work on God's house: {{units:about 190 tons|5,000 talents}} of gold, and {{units:about 185 pounds|10,000 darics}} more in gold coins, {{units:about 375 tons|10,000 talents}} of silver, {{units:about 675 tons|18,000 talents}} of bronze and {{units:about 3,750 tons|100,000 talents}} of iron.

es.L: Y dieron para el servicio de la casa de Dios: oro, 5000 talentos y 10 000 dáricos; y plata, 10 000 talentos; y bronce, 18 000 talentos; y hierro, 100 000 talentos.
es.B: Para el servicio de la casa de Dios dieron {{units:unas 170 toneladas|5000 talentos}} y {{units:unos 84 kilos|10 000 dáricos}} de oro, {{units:unas 340 toneladas|10 000 talentos}} de plata, {{units:unas 610 toneladas|18 000 talentos}} de bronce y {{units:unas 3400 toneladas|100 000 talentos}} de hierro.
es.R: Dieron todo esto para la obra de la casa de Dios: {{units:unas 170 toneladas|5000 talentos}} de oro, y {{units:unos 84 kilos|10 000 dáricos}} más en monedas de oro, {{units:unas 340 toneladas|10 000 talentos}} de plata, {{units:unas 610 toneladas|18 000 talentos}} de bronce y {{units:unas 3400 toneladas|100 000 talentos}} de hierro.

fr.L: Et ils donnèrent pour le service de la maison de Dieu : en or, 5 000 talents et 10 000 dariques ; et en argent, 10 000 talents ; et en bronze, 18 000 talents ; et en fer, 100 000 talents.
fr.B: Pour le service de la maison de Dieu, ils donnèrent {{units:environ 170 tonnes|5 000 talents}} et {{units:environ 85 kg|10 000 dariques}} d’or, {{units:environ 340 tonnes|10 000 talents}} d’argent, {{units:environ 610 tonnes|18 000 talents}} de bronze et {{units:environ 3 400 tonnes|100 000 talents}} de fer.

sw.L: Wakatoa kwa ajili ya huduma ya nyumba ya Mungu: dhahabu, talanta 5,000 na darkoni 10,000; na fedha, talanta 10,000; na shaba, talanta 18,000; na chuma, talanta 100,000.
sw.B: Kwa ajili ya huduma ya nyumba ya Mungu walitoa {{units:karibu tani 170|talanta 5,000}} na {{units:karibu kilo 84|darkoni 10,000}} za dhahabu, {{units:karibu tani 340|talanta 10,000}} za fedha, {{units:karibu tani 610|talanta 18,000}} za shaba na {{units:karibu tani 3,400|talanta 100,000}} za chuma.
sw.R: Walitoa vitu hivi vyote kwa ajili ya kazi ya nyumba ya Mungu: {{units:karibu tani 170|talanta 5,000}} za dhahabu, na {{units:karibu kilo 84|darkoni 10,000}} zaidi za sarafu za dhahabu, {{units:karibu tani 340|talanta 10,000}} za fedha, {{units:karibu tani 610|talanta 18,000}} za shaba na {{units:karibu tani 3,400|talanta 100,000}} za chuma.

vi.L: Họ dâng cho công việc nhà Đức Chúa Trời: vàng, 5.000 ta-lâng và 10.000 đa-riếc; bạc, 10.000 ta-lâng; đồng, 18.000 ta-lâng; và sắt, 100.000 ta-lâng.
vi.B: Họ dâng cho công việc nhà Đức Chúa Trời {{units:khoảng 170 tấn|5.000 ta-lâng}} và {{units:khoảng 84 kg|10.000 đa-riếc}} vàng, {{units:khoảng 340 tấn|10.000 ta-lâng}} bạc, {{units:khoảng 612 tấn|18.000 ta-lâng}} đồng và {{units:khoảng 3.400 tấn|100.000 ta-lâng}} sắt.
vi.R: Họ dâng tất cả những thứ này cho công việc xây nhà Đức Chúa Trời: {{units:khoảng 170 tấn|5.000 ta-lâng}} vàng, thêm {{units:khoảng 84 kg|10.000 đa-riếc}} tiền vàng nữa, {{units:khoảng 340 tấn|10.000 ta-lâng}} bạc, {{units:khoảng 612 tấn|18.000 ta-lâng}} đồng và {{units:khoảng 3.400 tấn|100.000 ta-lâng}} sắt.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 하나님의 집의 섬기는 일을 위해 금 5,000달란트와 10,000다릭, 은 10,000달란트, 놋쇠 18,000달란트, 철 100,000달란트를 드렸다.
ko.B: 그들은 하나님의 집에서 섬기는 일을 위해 금 {{units:170톤쯤|5,000달란트}}과 금 {{units:84킬로그램쯤|10,000다릭}}, 은 {{units:340톤쯤|10,000달란트}}, 놋쇠 {{units:612톤쯤|18,000달란트}}, 철 {{units:3,400톤쯤|100,000달란트}}을 드렸다.
ko.R: 그들은 하나님의 성전에서 할 일을 위해 이것들을 드렸다. 금 {{units:170톤쯤|5,000달란트}}과 금화로 {{units:84킬로그램쯤|10,000다릭}}을 더 드렸고, 은 {{units:340톤쯤|10,000달란트}}, 놋쇠 {{units:612톤쯤|18,000달란트}}, 철 {{units:3,400톤쯤|100,000달란트}}을 드렸다.

decisions.choice: darics: Persian gold coins
decisions.reason: The daric was a gold coin first struck under the Persian king Darius I, about five hundred years after David, weighing a little under a third of an ounce. There were no coins in David's day, so the writer of Chronicles, who lived in the Persian period, states part of the gift in the money his own readers used. Some take the word instead as the Greek drachma (a related word appears in Ezra 2:69 and Nehemiah 7:69).

decisions.choice: the service of the house of God: the work of building and furnishing it
decisions.reason: Here 'service' means the work on the temple, as in 28:13-14, 20, not only the worship later carried on in it.

decisions.choice: talents: as in verse 4
decisions.reason: As in verse 4, the figures are immense; the iron alone would weigh about 3,750 tons. The bronze is counted in Hebrew as 'ten thousand and eight thousand' talents.

decisions.choice: modern weight, with talents and darics as the alternative
decisions.reason: A talent is about 75 pounds. A daric weighed about 8.4 grams, so 10,000 darics is about 185 pounds of gold. Readable adds 'in gold coins' so the reader knows a daric is a coin.

decisions.choice: unos 84 kilos (10 000 dáricos); talents at 34 kg
decisions.reason: A daric, a Persian gold coin, weighed about 8.4 g; the English "about 185 pounds" is the same weight.

decisions.choice: metric weights (a talent 34 kg; a daric 8.4 g), with "talanta" and "darkoni" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The metric default is reckoned from the same values as the English conversion; the Persian gold coin is "darkoni", from the Hebrew name.

decisions.choice: "đa-riếc"; {{units:khoảng 84 kg|10.000 đa-riếc}} at B, R
decisions.reason: The Persian gold coin keeps its name, transliterated, with its weight (about 8.4 g each) as the metric default, as the English gives it in pounds.

decisions.choice: {{units:84킬로그램쯤|10,000다릭}} and the talents in tonnes
decisions.reason: A daric weighed about 8.4 g; Readable says it was a gold coin ("금화"), as the English Readable does.

source.text: וְהַנִּמְצָ֤א אִתּוֹ֙ אֲבָנִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ לְאוֹצַ֣ר בֵּית־יְהוָ֑ה עַ֥ל יַד־יְחִיאֵ֖ל הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And the [one] found with him stones gave [them] to [the] treasury of [the] house of Yahweh, into [the] hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

en.L: And whoever had stones found with him gave [them] to the treasury of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, into the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
en.B: Any who owned precious stones handed them over to the treasury of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.
en.R: Those who had jewels gave them to the treasury of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Jehiel, from the Levite clan of Gershon, took charge of them.

es.L: Y el que tenía piedras [preciosas] las dio al tesoro de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, en mano de Jehiel el gersonita.
es.B: Los que tenían piedras preciosas las entregaron al tesoro de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, al cuidado de Jehiel el gersonita.
es.R: Los que tenían joyas las dieron al tesoro de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Jehiel, del clan levita de Gersón, se hizo cargo de ellas.

fr.L: Et celui chez qui se trouvaient des pierres [les] donna au trésor de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, entre les mains de Yehiel le Guershonite.
fr.B: Ceux qui possédaient des pierres précieuses les remirent au trésor de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, sous la garde de Yehiel le Guershonite.
fr.R: Ceux qui avaient des pierres précieuses les ont données au trésor de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Yehiel, du clan lévite de Guershon, en a pris la responsabilité.

sw.L: Na yeyote aliyeonekana kuwa na mawe akayatoa kwa hazina ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mkononi mwa Yehieli Mgershoni.
sw.B: Wote waliokuwa na mawe ya thamani waliyatoa kwa hazina ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, chini ya utunzaji wa Yehieli Mgershoni.
sw.R: Wale waliokuwa na vito waliyatoa kwa hazina ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Yehieli, wa ukoo wa Kilawi wa Gershoni, aliyatunza.

vi.L: Ai có đá [quý] thì dâng [đá ấy] vào kho báu của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, giao vào tay Giê-hi-ên người Ghẹt-sôn.
vi.B: Những ai có đá quý đều dâng vào kho báu của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, giao cho Giê-hi-ên người Ghẹt-sôn coi sóc.
vi.R: Những người có đá quý dâng vào kho báu của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Giê-hi-ên, thuộc gia tộc Ghẹt-sôn của người Lê-vi, coi giữ các đá quý ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 보석이 [있는] 사람은 그것을 게르손 사람 여히엘의 손에 맡겨 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 곳간에 드렸다.
ko.B: 보석을 가진 사람들은 그것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 보물 창고에 드려 게르손 사람 여히엘에게 맡겼다.
ko.R: 보석을 가진 사람들은 그것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 보물 창고에 드렸다. 레위인 게르손 집안의 여히엘이 그것을 맡았다.

decisions.choice: stones: precious stones
decisions.reason: After the precious stones of verse 2, 'stones' here means gems.

decisions.choice: into the hand of Jehiel: in his care
decisions.reason: Jehiel the Gershonite, a Levite, was in charge of the temple treasuries (23:8; 26:21-22).

decisions.choice: from the Levite clan of Gershon
decisions.reason: Readable explains the clan name.

source.text: וַיִּשְׂמְח֤וּ הָעָם֙ עַל־הִֽתְנַדְּבָ֔ם כִּ֚י בְּלֵ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם הִֽתְנַדְּב֖וּ לַיהוָ֑ה וְגַם֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׂמַ֖ח שִׂמְחָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And rejoiced the people over their offering willingly, for with a heart whole they offered willingly to Yahweh; and also David the king rejoiced [with] joy great.

en.L: And the people rejoiced over their offering willingly, for with a whole heart they offered willingly to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and David the king also rejoiced [with] great joy.
en.B: The people rejoiced over these freewill gifts, for with a whole heart they had given freely to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. King David also rejoiced with great joy.
en.R: The people were very happy about these gifts, because they had been given freely and with all their heart to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. King David was also full of joy.

es.L: Y se alegró el pueblo por haber ofrecido voluntariamente, porque con corazón íntegro ofrecieron voluntariamente {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; y también el rey David se alegró [con] gran alegría.
es.B: El pueblo se alegró por estas ofrendas voluntarias, porque de todo corazón habían dado de buena gana {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. También el rey David se alegró con gran alegría.
es.R: El pueblo estaba muy contento por estas ofrendas, porque las habían dado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de buena gana y de todo corazón. El rey David también estaba lleno de alegría.

fr.L: Et le peuple se réjouit de ce qu’ils avaient donné de bon cœur, car c’est d’un cœur entier qu’ils avaient donné de bon cœur {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; et le roi David aussi se réjouit d’une grande joie.
fr.B: Le peuple se réjouit de ces dons volontaires, car c’est d’un cœur entier qu’ils avaient donné librement {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Le roi David, lui aussi, fut rempli d’une grande joie.
fr.R: Le peuple était très heureux de ces dons, parce qu’ils avaient été faits librement et de tout cœur {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Le roi David, lui aussi, était plein de joie.

sw.L: Watu wakafurahi kwa kutoa kwao kwa hiari, kwa maana kwa moyo mkamilifu walimtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hiari; naye mfalme Daudi pia akafurahi [kwa] furaha kuu.
sw.B: Watu walifurahi kwa ajili ya matoleo hayo ya hiari, kwa maana walikuwa wamemtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hiari kwa moyo mkamilifu. Mfalme Daudi naye alifurahi kwa furaha kuu.
sw.R: Watu walifurahi sana kwa ajili ya zawadi hizo, kwa sababu zilikuwa zimetolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hiari na kwa moyo wote. Mfalme Daudi naye alijaa furaha.

vi.L: Dân chúng vui mừng vì họ đã tự nguyện dâng hiến, vì họ đã dâng hiến cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} với lòng trọn vẹn; vua Đa-vít cũng vui mừng [với] niềm vui lớn.
vi.B: Dân chúng vui mừng vì những lễ vật tự nguyện này, vì họ đã hết lòng sẵn lòng dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua Đa-vít cũng rất đỗi vui mừng.
vi.R: Dân chúng rất vui về những lễ vật này, vì họ đã dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cách tự nguyện và hết lòng. Vua Đa-vít cũng tràn đầy niềm vui.

ko.L: 그리고 백성이 그들이 기꺼이 드린 것을 기뻐했다. 그들이 온전한 마음으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기꺼이 드렸기 때문이다. 그리고 다윗 왕도 큰 기쁨으로 기뻐했다.
ko.B: 백성은 자원하여 드린 예물을 보며 기뻐했다. 그들이 온전한 마음으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기꺼이 드렸기 때문이다. 다윗 왕도 크게 기뻐했다.
ko.R: 백성은 이 예물들을 보고 몹시 기뻐했다. 그들이 온 마음을 다해 기꺼이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드렸기 때문이다. 다윗 왕도 기쁨에 넘쳤다.

decisions.choice: their offering: the giving of the leaders, or of all who gave
decisions.reason: 'They' may be the leaders of verse 6, whose generosity made the people glad, or the people themselves, glad at their own giving. The verse does not say, and the wording keeps both open.

decisions.choice: with a whole heart: with undivided, sincere devotion
decisions.reason: A 'whole heart' is undivided loyalty (28:9; 1 Kings 8:61). David prays for the same heart for Solomon in verse 19.

decisions.choice: with all their heart
decisions.reason: Readable uses the familiar phrase for 'a whole heart'.

source.text: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד בָּר֨וּךְ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֔ינוּ מֵעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And blessed David Yahweh before [the] eyes of all the assembly, and said David, Blessed [are] you, Yahweh, God of Israel our father, from everlasting and to everlasting.

en.L: And David blessed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} before the eyes of all the assembly, and David said, "Blessed [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel our father, from everlasting and to everlasting.
en.B: Then David blessed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the sight of the whole assembly. David said, "Blessed are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
en.R: Then David praised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in front of all the people gathered there. He said, "Praise be to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of our ancestor Israel, for ever and ever.

es.L: Y bendijo David {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} ante los ojos de toda la asamblea, y dijo David: «Bendito [eres] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel nuestro padre, desde la eternidad y hasta la eternidad.
es.B: Entonces David bendijo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en presencia de toda la asamblea. David dijo: «Bendito eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de nuestro padre Israel, desde la eternidad hasta la eternidad.
es.R: Entonces David alabó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} delante de todos los reunidos allí. Dijo: «Alabado seas {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de nuestro antepasado Israel, por siempre y para siempre.

fr.L: Et David bénit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aux yeux de toute l’assemblée, et David dit : « Béni [sois]-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël notre père, d’éternité en éternité.
fr.B: Alors David bénit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} devant toute l’assemblée. David dit : « Béni sois-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël notre père, d’éternité en éternité !
fr.R: Alors David a loué {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} devant tous ceux qui étaient rassemblés. Il a dit : « Louange à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu de notre ancêtre Israël, pour toujours et à jamais !

sw.B: Kisha Daudi akamhimidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mbele ya kusanyiko lote. Daudi akasema, "Uhimidiwe {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba yetu Israeli, tangu milele hata milele.

vi.L: Đa-vít chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trước mắt toàn thể hội chúng. Đa-vít nói: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên tổ phụ chúng con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được chúc tụng từ đời đời cho đến đời đời.
